purpose: Probe-by-probe classification of the production-like readiness harness execution requested for the current release review. Every PASS is tied to an actually executed test with a run identifier. Preflight, static, mocked and bounded evidence is classified separately and is never counted as execution evidence.

classification_vocabulary.PASS (EXECUTED): An actual test ran against real services/runtime and its result is recorded in immutable evidence.
classification_vocabulary.PASS (EXECUTED) / SCOPED: Executed, but the harness itself states a scope limit; the limit is reproduced verbatim.
classification_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Some sub-probes genuinely executed and passed; other named sub-probes did not execute and stay BLOCKED.
classification_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Required sub-probe was not executed anywhere; no claim is made.
classification_vocabulary.ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED: The requested host/runner cannot provide the capability; recorded instead of simulated.
classification_vocabulary.PASS / BOUNDED: Real local harness execution with synthetic filesystem-shaped fixtures; explicitly not production evidence.
classification_vocabulary.FAIL (EXECUTED): An actual test ran and genuinely failed. Recorded as a defect, never reclassified.

reason: No docker, docker-compose or podman binary is installed and /var/run/docker.sock does not exist.
Docker Engine cannot be installed: the Debian apt mirrors (deb.debian.org) and download.docker.com are both unreachable from this sandbox, so apt-get update fails and no package index exists.
/lib/modules is absent, so kernel modules required for container networking/storage cannot be loaded, and /proc is mounted read-only.
Resources are below the production-like envelope: 2 vCPU and ~3.8 GiB RAM, against a full Frappe/ERPNext/Education/HRMS bench plus MariaDB and Redis.

Consequence: every live-service probe (MariaDB durability/restart, Redis persistence/restart recovery, deployed Frappe runtime, TLS/edge, monitoring delivery) is ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED on this host and must be executed on a Docker-capable runner instead.
requested_local_sandbox.conclusion: This host cannot execute the production-like harness. Per the evidence rules it is recorded as ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED and no local check-only or preflight result is substituted for execution evidence.

gates_that_newly_passed: No D8 release gate flips to PASS from this execution. Every executed pass is scoped/synthetic or partial, and each corresponding D8 gate keeps its prior BLOCKED/REJECT state.
release_decision.rationale: Fresh genuine execution on a Docker-capable runner materially increases the amount of real evidence and confirms the native runtime, authorization containment, backup/restore mechanics and integrity verification behave as designed. It does not close the D8 gates because: MariaDB/Redis restart persistence and durability were never executed; restore never reached a genuinely independent system and no destructive trigger was run; versioned encrypted backup with external key custody and rotation exists only as a bounded local proof while the foundation restore actually failed to carry the site encryption key; deployed monitoring, alert delivery, retention and fail-closed behavior were not exercised; no TLS or Tailscale boundary was tested; rollback was never rehearsed; and SEC-DEPS-01 fails again on this exact branch. Production therefore remains REJECT.
